turns.teacherReply: Physical change means only shape, size, or state changes; no new substance forms. Melting ghee and dissolving sugar are examples. Can you name one physical change?

move.shape: one idea only: Define a physical change (no new substance; only shape, size or state changes) and give examples; an example from their interest (drawing) if it fits naturally; objects first, then the symbol; point at the screen only at what the on-screen row lists; never a drawing made of characters; end with one small question that makes them USE the idea — never 'samjha?'
